{"id":1548394772,"question_id":1516,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 5 months","timestamp":1739959509,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1548394772/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"The k-th Lexicographical String of All Happy Strings of Length n","memory":"9 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n\n    int count = 0 ;\n    string result = \"\";\n\n    void recursion(int n , int k , string current)\n    {\n        //base case \n        if(current.size() == n)\n        {\n            count ++;\n            if(count == k)\n            {\n                result = current ;\n            }\n            return;\n        }\n\n        //ek case solve krdenge baaki recursion kardega \n        char array[3] = {'a' ,'b' , 'c'};\n        for(char ch : array)\n        {\n            if(current.empty() or current.back() != ch)\n            {\n                recursion(n , k , current + ch);\n\n                if(!result.empty()) return;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    string getHappyString(int n, int k) {\n        recursion( n , k , \"\");\n        return result;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"the-k-th-lexicographical-string-of-all-happy-strings-of-length-n","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":349}
